articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Audio, Video, and Code
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can process interleaved video, audio, and code inputs in a single context window of 1M tokens. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on ARC-AGI-2 over the previous generation, with notably stronger performance on long-horizon agentic tasks. The model is available via API with a new streaming tool-use protocol that reduces agent latency by roughly 60%.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Frontier Math Benchmark
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 81% of problems on the Frontier Math benchmark, up from roughly 25% just twelve months ago, using a novel chain-of-verification approach combined with reinforcement learning over formal proof assistants. The result marks a significant milestone in AI mathematical reasoning and has drawn attention from the research community for its implications on automated theorem proving and scientific discovery workflows.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoids in BMW Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Figure Robotics announced that its third-generation humanoid robot, Figure 03, has entered full commercial deployment at two BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina. The robots handle complex multi-step assembly tasks including wire harness routing and panel fitting, guided by a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on factory teleoperation data. BMW reports a 23% throughput improvement in the pilot zones with lower defect rates than manual operation.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion in Extended Real-World Trials
articles.summary: Tesla shared results from a 90-day in-home trial of 50 Optimus Gen 3 units, showing the humanoid robot can autonomously perform laundry folding, dishwasher loading, and basic meal prep with a task success rate exceeding 92%. The system uses an end-to-end transformer policy trained on over 200,000 hours of teleoperation data. Tesla confirmed plans to begin limited consumer sales in Q1 2027 at an initial price point near $25,000.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Claude Researcher' — an Autonomous Agent for End-to-End Scientific Literature Review
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude Researcher, an agentic system built on Claude 4 that can autonomously search academic databases, read full papers, synthesize findings, and produce structured literature reviews with citations. In evaluations by domain experts across biomedicine and materials science, the system's reviews were rated comparable to those by postdoctoral researchers in accuracy and coverage. The tool integrates with institutional library access and respects publisher API rate limits.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node, Enabling Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed the start of volume production on its N1.4 process node using second-generation gate-all-around transistors at its Fab 20 facility in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. The node delivers a 25% power efficiency improvement and 15% performance gain over N2, with early customers including Apple and NVIDIA for next-generation AI training chips expected in early 2027. Analysts project this will be critical for supporting increasingly large foundation model training runs within viable power envelopes.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface for Paralysis Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted full approval for Neuralink's N2 implant, a 4,096-electrode brain-computer interface designed for patients with severe paralysis. Clinical trial data showed participants could control cursor movement, robotic arms, and speech synthesizers with latency under 50ms and accuracy improvements of 40% over the first-generation device. The approval covers both tetraplegic and locked-in syndrome indications, making it the most capable commercially approved BCI to date.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with 1.2 Trillion Active Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a 1.2T active-parameter mixture-of-experts model, under a revised open-source license that permits commercial use with minimal restrictions. The model matches or exceeds GPT-5 on several public benchmarks including MMLU-Pro, HumanEval+, and multilingual reasoning tasks. The release includes LoRA adapters, quantized variants down to 4-bit, and a reference distributed inference stack optimized for clusters of consumer GPUs.
